title: Front view battle in 2003 problem, animations and numbers

posts.author: zeoxdragon
posts.body:
I was messing around RPG Maker 2003 just trying stuff for the fun of it, I wanted to see if I could make a Front view battle, so I made the Hero sprites blank and put them in a corner, the problem is when the enemy attacks, well... you can see the animation is snitching where the invisible hero is, since the animation is happening on a corner of the screen and even the number appears.
I also tried to put the hero under the text box, but you still can see the top of the animation:
I don't know if there's a way to make enemies animations to not show? I also tried to put the invisible hero in the exact middle of the screen, so it would look like the animation is simply appearing in the middle of the screen, but then it looks like the enemy is the one getting hurt, besides if there are two enemies on the sides of the screen, one of them will flip it's sprite to look at where the hero is supposed to be.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
You would have to create a list of skills without animations just for the playable characters.
Many years ago I did two tech demos trying to make this type of battle with faceset, for that you need to go to Database => Battle Screen => Interface and change to
Type C
